description: Insert an image into a Google Slides slide from a publicly accessible URL

account.description: Alias of the Google account to target. Optional — defaults to the session/global default account, or the sole authenticated account. Run manage_accounts list to see available aliases.

imageUrl.description: Publicly accessible URL of the image

pageObjectId.description: Slide/page object ID to insert the image into

name: insertSlidesImageFromUrl
